purpose: Give direct advice about a useful action or restraint.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary / Vない + ことだ
If you want to improve, practice every day, even briefly.
When you are tired, the thing to do is avoid overexerting yourself.
If you get lost, ask someone before too long.
formation: V dictionary / Vない + ことだ
restrictions: Usually advice from someone speaking with experience or authority.
mistake: May sound patronizing when directed at a superior.
